plain.li: [trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] Every bang in the night has me sitting up in bed, so please, some quiet.
Someone sawed wood until midnight again, and no shelf is worth that.
[trait:Ascetic] Early to bed and early up, the way people lived before there was anything to stay up for.
[night] It's the middle of the night and somebody is still hammering.

warm.li: We're all tired and short with each other, and a few quiet evenings would do us good.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I lie awake every night listening to the rest of you having a better time than me.

cold.li: Most arguments here start after dark, so take away the evenings and you take away the arguments.

plain.li: [trait:NightOwl] I do my best work while the rest of you sleep, and now I'm supposed to sleep too?
[skill:Social] The only time anyone talks to each other here is after supper.
[winter] It's dark by the middle of the afternoon, so quiet hours means quiet days.

blunt.li: [trait:NightOwl] I don't sleep at night. Never have.

cheerful.li: Fine, quiet hours, but nobody said anything about quiet card games.

gloomy.li: So we sit in the dark and listen to each other breathe. Wonderful.

plain.li: [newcomer] I've been here a week, and some of you I still haven't spoken to.
People eat standing up, alone, in a hurry, and that's no way to live.
[trait:Kind] Each of us should have a seat and someone to pass the bread.

warm.li: [skill:Social] I want to hear about everyone's day, all of it, over supper.
[winter] Long dark evenings go faster with a full table.

cheerful.li: Shared supper, and I'll lay a place for every one of us!

cold.li: Grudges grow when people avoid each other. Make them sit together.

plain.li: [trait:Abrasive] I don't want to look at most of these people while I'm eating.
[trait:Ascetic] A bowl and a quiet corner is all a meal needs.
[trait:Industrious] I was in the middle of something, and supper can wait.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] I'll eat with them when I like them.

gloomy.li: Every meal the same faces and the same conversations.

plain.li: [skill:Medicine] I can't treat anyone who won't stay in bed.
[trait:Sickly] I catch everything that comes through here, so keep the sick ones in bed.
[hurt] I've been limping about for a week, and I'd stay in bed if anyone let me.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Bed rest for the sick, and for the very tired too, I hope.

warm.li: Don't work through a fever just to look tough.

cold.li: [skill:Medicine] One sick worker on their feet costs us three sick workers in a week.

plain.li: [trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I've never missed a day's work for a cough and I'm not starting now.
[trait:Tough] A bit of blood never stopped anyone.

cheerful.li: I feel fine! Mostly fine. Fine enough to work, anyway.

plain.li: [winter] Burning like this, we won't see the spring; go and look at the woodpile.
[trait:Ascetic] A coat indoors never hurt anyone.
[trait:Greedy] Every log we don't burn is a log we don't have to chop or buy.
[lowtech] Bank the fire at night, my mother used to say, and you'll still have one in the morning.

cold.li: Fuel in, heat out, and we're burning more than we need.

gloomy.li: Better a cold month than a dead winter.

plain.li: [trait:Wimp] My fingers are blue. Actually blue. Look.
[old] My bones can't take the cold the way they used to.
[cold] It's freezing out and you want to bank the fires?

blunt.li: I can't work with numb hands.

warm.li: [child] Can I keep my candle until I fall asleep?

gloomy.li: Dark at supper, dark at breakfast, cold in between.

plain.li: [small] There are too few of us for anyone to know only one trade.
[newcomer] I'd learn anything, if someone would show me.
[trait:Kind] Each of us knows something worth passing on.
[old] I won't be around forever. Somebody should learn what I know.

warm.li: [skill:Social] I love teaching, so give me a student and a whole afternoon.

cheerful.li: I'm going to learn to cook, and then to build!

cold.li: Every skill held by one person is a weak point, so spread them around.

plain.li: [trait:Abrasive] Watching someone else ruin my work is not teaching.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] More lessons on top of the work, lovely.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] Learn by watching, and without talking.

gloomy.li: They'll learn just enough to be dangerous with a saw.

plain.li: [fall] The harvest is in, and we should eat some of it while it's fresh.
[trait:Gourmand] One good meal, just one, with everything on the table together.
[lowmood] We need something to look forward to, and a good meal is something.
[lowtech] My people always ate a great meal when the harvest came in, to thank the land.

warm.li: Let's eat together, properly, all of us, before the cold comes.

cheerful.li: [trait:Gourmand] I've been planning the menu for weeks! I've even planned the second helpings.

blunt.li: [trait:Greedy] If we've got it, we should be eating it.

plain.li: [trait:Ascetic] We'll eat a week's stores in a day and call it celebrating.
[trait:Industrious] Half a day's work lost for a meal.
[winter] Feasting now, with the stores this low? We'll be counting the bowls by spring.

cold.li: Food eaten today is food missing in a month.
